title: Say Pabelat ya Angitarok na Panamaabig
intro: Say kamarerwa ya asubok ya ag nasukat et naekal ed ligliwa, kakaiba, tan biskeg na laman. Lapud nisulinek ed aralem a kairapan, sayan lingkor nen Allah et inmarap labat ed Dios. Diad panamegley na ag-onkupas ya anos tan impapuson pikakasi, sinmabi so daluyon na panangasi ya alampasan toy amin ya iilaloan. Siopa iyan pigura ya say debosyon to so angilukas na puerta na kipawil?
clues: Siak so sakey a paboriton lingkor nen Allah, a manggagayaga ed inkadaakan, maaligwas a sankaabungan, tan maong a bunigas nen panaon ko.
Insan sinmabi so sakey a subok: naandi so kayamanan, naandi iray inad-aro, tan say laman ko so tinamaan na graben kairapan.
Saramay asingger ed siak et agmakatepel ed kipapasen ko, tan siak so atilak a nisulinek, say laman ko so napno na paniirap.
Tinmawag ak ed Katawan ko, ya inyabawag ko ya diniwit ak nen Satanas na kapagaan tan dusa.
Sinmabi so ebat — sakey a ganggan ya igatin-gatin so salik ed dalin, tan manlapud satan et ompaway so ambetel a danum parad pakatambal.
Inekal na Katawan ko so kairapan tan impawil tod siak so pamilyak, ya dinmakel, bilang tanda na panangasi parad saramay mannononot.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
